title: THE WALKABLE SURFACE — Spectrum Synthesis for Humans to Explore the HUD
what_kevin_sees: The thymus (self/non-self), IS/WAS/NOW (temporal), human IPs, our summer work, shadow cast — ALL of this is a SPECTRUM that needs to be SYNTHESIZABLE. Color = campfire stories = smoke. The HUD must be a walkable surface for humans like Kevin to EXPLORE.

the_walkable_surface_vision.metaphor: The HUD is not a DASHBOARD. It's a LANDSCAPE. Kevin walks THROUGH it like he walks between the two houses.
the_walkable_surface_vision.spectrum: Color IS the campfire stories. Each visitor's path through the mesh leaves a COLOR TRAIL. The SMOKE rising from the campfire IS the data radiating through RSS/WAN/Tor. Synesthesia: data→color→sound→feel.

is_was_now.IS: Live feeds — topology, pulse, cron beats, gate status, senses
is_was_now.WAS: Fossils — wateringHole archives, bearDog genesis, wave history
is_was_now.NOW: The current moment — this prompt, this wave, this coffee
